title: Use the Cancellations report
summary: Appointments canceled or no-shows in the period, with reason, doctor and patient.

steps.title: Menu → Reports → Cancellations
steps.details: Appointments canceled or no-shows in the period, with reason, doctor and patient.

steps.title: Period
steps.details: Today, this week, this month, last month, this year or your own range.

steps.title: Filters
steps.details: Doctor, reason and type (cancellation or no-show).

steps.title: Generate
steps.details: Calculates the report with the chosen filters.

steps.title: No data
steps.details: There's no data for those filters: try another period.

steps.title: Indicators
steps.details: Total cancellations, main reason, most affected doctor and most frequent patient.

steps.title: Results
steps.details: Charts by reason, day and hour, and the details of each cancellation.

steps.title: Details
steps.details: Sort by column by tapping the header.

steps.title: Export
steps.details: Excel, CSV or PDF with what you're viewing.
